description: Heatmap: Spatiotemporal Traffic Speed Graphics using Connected Vehicle Data is a data set deposited in Purdue University Research Repository by its authors Rahul Sakhare, Jairaj Desai. p This dataset provides 286,065 connected vehicle trajectory data waypoints for a day on Thursday, May 11, 2023, over 15 miles section of interstate on I-69 northbound in Indiana. The trajectory data provides information for more than 0.2 million individual waypoints about timestamp and location. Temporal frequency of waypoints is 3 to 5 seconds. Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. Formats: TXT, CSV, Video. Size stated: 5 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-NC-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
